# Golden Horizont Egypt
> Premium tours and excursions across Egypt. Snorkeling, diving, desert safaris, historical tours to Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, and exclusive Red Sea adventures since 2015.

## About
- [About Golden Horizont Egypt](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/about): Egypt-wide travel agency with 69+ unique trips, 5000+ happy travelers, 10+ years of experience, and 4.9 average rating.

## Popular Trips
- [Giftun Island Snorkeling](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/giftun-island-snorkeling): Full-day snorkeling trip to Giftun Island National Park, coral reefs, lunch, transfers from Hurghada.
- [Orange Bay Island](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/orange-bay-island): Pristine white beach, crystal waters, snorkeling, lunch buffet, boat trip from Hurghada.
- [Dolphin House Reef](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/dolphin-house-reef): Swim with wild dolphins in the Red Sea, snorkeling at Dolphin House, lunch on board.
- [Super Safari Adventure](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/super-safari-adventure): Quad biking, camel ride, Bedouin dinner, stargazing desert experience.
- [Luxor Day Trip](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/luxor-day-trip): Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon, lunch.
- [Cairo & Pyramids Tour](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/cairo-pyramids-tour): Giza Pyramids, Sphinx, Egyptian Museum, Khan El Khalili bazaar, flights included.
- [Introduction to Diving](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/introduction-to-diving): Beginner scuba diving course in the Red Sea, certified instructors, all equipment.
- [Mahmya Island](https://goldenhorizontegypt.com/trip/mahmya-island): Exclusive island beach day, snorkeling, BBQ lunch, relaxing at Mahmya Reserve.
